rooms.name: Tser Falls
rooms.desc: A tremor comes up through the bare rock before any sound does. West of the span a black tarn slips over its sill and is swallowed by cloud; ravens sit hunched on the two northern gargoyles, and past the saddle's edge the whole valley lies far below.
rooms.dm: Climb: magic or a climber's kit only. Crossing: no check (wet but sound). Gargoyles: decoration. Roads: F to the south, I to the north. East of the road: a sheer drop of nearly 400 ft to the pines below (20d6). Below the span: the Cauldron, nearly 1,000 ft down; its river runs on to the Vistani at G. Encounters: wilderness tables (p.29).

rooms.name: The bridge
rooms.desc: Fifteen feet of wet, green-black paving between waist-high parapets furred with moss; a tremor runs through it and cold spray drifts across.
rooms.dm: Ninety feet abutment to abutment, about seventy of them over the void. Room for a wagon or a shield wall of three; nobody can be flanked here. The two northern gargoyles carry the ravens.

objects.label: The shelf road
objects.desc: A rutted shelf hacked along the mountain's flank: cut rock rising on the uphill side, a crumbling edge and loose stone on the other, the ruts brimming with rainwater.

objects.label: The chasm
objects.desc: A sheer slot in the mountain, its wet walls streaming, dropping away into billowing white cloud. No bottom shows; cold air pours up over the lips and the ground trembles underfoot.

objects.label: The sill of the falls
objects.desc: The tarn slides over a glossy undercut lip of rock and simply vanishes into its own cloud a few dozen feet down.

objects.label: Spray plume
objects.desc: Cold mist boils up out of the head of the chasm and drifts east over the bridge; everything near the sill is soaked.

objects.label: The tarn
objects.desc: The fast clear river from the west slows into a cold black pond held against the sill; pine needles drift toward the spill.

objects.label: The bridge over Tser Falls
objects.desc: A single arch of green-black stone leaps the chasm, furred with mould and black moss, its deck slick with spray. Fifteen feet wide, parapets waist-high.

objects.label: Moss-cloaked gargoyle
objects.desc: A crouched stone gargoyle on the corner post, shaggy with black moss, its frown worn to a blur.

objects.label: Moss-cloaked gargoyle
objects.desc: A crouched stone gargoyle on the corner post, shaggy with black moss, its frown worn to a blur.

objects.desc: A crouched stone gargoyle on the corner post, shaggy with black moss, its frown worn to a blur.

objects.label: The Wizard's Precipice
objects.desc: A flat-topped spur of dark rock 35 ft above the road, overlooking the sill and the whole drop; a scramble of broken steps climbs its east shoulder.

objects.label: Rockfall
objects.desc: A raw pale scar on the precipice's south face and a fan of fresh angular boulders, none of them yet lichened, spilling to the tarn shore.

objects.label: Lightning star: fused rock and a charred stump (spell duel)
objects.desc: A star of black scorch burned into the bare rock, the stone at its heart fused to a dull crazed glass; a pine stump beside it charred a foot high.
objects.dm: A year old. Detect magic: faint evocation. DC 12 Arcana reads the scorch and the rockfall scar together as a spell duel, as the Vistana at G tells it (p.37).

objects.label: Iron pin and frayed rope: the climb route
objects.playerLabel: A rusted iron pin and a rope
objects.desc: A rusted iron pin driven into a crack, a frayed rope knotted to it, running to the edge and down the wall.
objects.dm: DC 15 Perception from the road. The only line a climber's kit can use: pins down the wall to the ledge 580 ft below (DC 15 Athletics per 100 ft, a failure drops 25 ft for 2d6 before the anchor holds).

objects.label: The anvil block
objects.desc: A wagon-sized slab split cleanly in two, the halves a foot apart, standing near the lip east of the bridge: a perch to watch the bridge from, and cover.

objects.label: Perched boulder
objects.desc: A cart-sized boulder perched on smaller stones, as if set down there.

objects.label: Perched boulder
objects.desc: A cart-sized boulder perched on smaller stones, as if set down there.

objects.label: Perched boulder
objects.desc: A cart-sized boulder perched on smaller stones, as if set down there.

objects.label: Raven litter
objects.desc: The rock under the northern gargoyles is white with droppings and strewn with fish spines, small bones, a button, a buckle and a bent spoon.

objects.label: Wereraven's cache: a bundle of plain clothes
objects.desc: A leather-wrapped bundle of drab Barovian clothes, sized for an adult, stuffed into a dry crack under the abutment.
objects.dm: DC 13 Perception, or anyone who looks at what the ravens guard. A Keeper of the Feather leaves it here to land, change and walk the road as a traveller (p.30).

objects.label: Trinket in the litter
objects.desc: Something small and metal half buried in the droppings.
objects.dm: Roll on the trinkets table (appendix A), or a pocket trinket that fell from the bridge and came back up on a raven's beak.

objects.label: Dire wolf (Strahd's)
objects.dm: Day 12 / night 10, 1d6 (p.29). They come up the road behind the party and reach the south end as it is mid-span. Cannot be charmed or frightened.

objects.label: Dire wolf (Strahd's)
objects.dm: Day 12 / night 10, 1d6 (p.29). They come up the road behind the party and reach the south end as it is mid-span. Cannot be charmed or frightened.

objects.dm: Day 12 / night 10, 1d6 (p.29). They come up the road behind the party and reach the south end as it is mid-span. Cannot be charmed or frightened.

objects.label: Ravens (Keepers' eyes) or a wereraven
objects.dm: Day 11 (p.29). Lift off when someone steps on the deck and circle the chasm; left alone they shadow the party toward I. 50%: a wereraven instead.

objects.label: Ravens (Keepers' eyes) or a wereraven
objects.dm: Day 11 (p.29). Lift off when someone steps on the deck and circle the chasm; left alone they shadow the party toward I. 50%: a wereraven instead.

objects.label: Swarm of bats
objects.dm: Night 9, 1d8 swarms (p.29). Roost under the arch and in the abutment's wet cracks; any light on the bridge after dark, or a loud noise, brings them boiling up from below the parapets.

objects.label: Swarm of bats

objects.dm: Night 9, 1d8 swarms (p.29). Roost under the arch and in the abutment's wet cracks; any light on the bridge after dark, or a loud noise, brings them boiling up from below the parapets.

objects.label: Ghost (in the spray at the sill)
objects.playerLabel: A pale shape in the spray
objects.dm: Night 2 (p.29-30). If it possesses someone it may walk the host to this chasm instead of J: the host lands in the Cauldron (pool level), 20d6.

objects.label: Skeletal rider and warhorse
objects.playerLabel: A rider on a pale horse
objects.dm: Day 8 / night 8 (p.29, p.31). Crosses the bridge north to south at a walk, ignoring the party unless attacked. Its raised lantern of rusted iron stays cold and dark: at night it is only hooves on wet stone.

objects.label: The bridge: slick but safe, no check to cross. A shove over the 3-ft parapet drops the target to the Cauldron (pool level): 20d6 and prone in the water. A reaction grab within 5 ft or feather fall can save them.
Within 60 ft of the sill: difficult ground, lightly obscured; in a gust the far end of the bridge is heavily obscured for a round. Fliers in the spray: DC 10 Str save to hold position.
From the precipice (and the bridge when the fog thins): Castle Ravenloft on its pillar 2.4 mi east, across the valley.
South: the road loops down the mountainside to the crossroads at F (about 6 mi, 2 hours). East of it the saddle ends in a sheer drop of nearly 400 ft to the valley.
North: the road squeezes between two crags and winds on to the fork at I (about 1.5 mi, 30 min).
Ravens perch on the two northern gargoyles; bats roost under the arch. The Keepers' cache is in the crack under the north abutment.
Vallaki, far off
objects.desc: Far to the north-west, beyond the falling valleys, the dark ring of Vallaki's palisade and its church tower stand on the horizon.

objects.label: Pines below the cliff
objects.desc: Far below the shelf road's crumbling edge the valley's pines begin, dark crowns crowding the slope.

objects.label: Fog in the valley
objects.desc: Far below the cliff, banks of fog lie in the pines and along the gorge the river runs out of.

objects.label: The escarpment
objects.desc: Past the saddle's edge the mountain simply stops: a sheer wall of dark rock drops hundreds of feet to the slope below, and the chasm leaves through a cleft in it.

rooms.name: The Vistana's ledge
rooms.desc: A wet shelf of rock on the north wall under a drift of spray, a stunted pine in its crack. Rusted iron pins and a frayed rope come down the wall above; a gully of loose stone drops away from its east end.
rooms.dm: About 380 ft above the pool and 580 ft below the deck: where a fallen or levitating character might fetch up, and the only rest on a climber's-kit descent. The Vistana came this way after the duel looking for valuables. From here, the gully to the pool needs DC 12 Acrobatics or a tumble (2d6) every 100 ft.

objects.label: Stunted pine
objects.desc: A stunted pine growing out of a crack in the shelf, bent out over the drop.

objects.label: Iron pins and a frayed rope
objects.desc: A line of rusted iron pins down the wall from far above, a frayed rope tied to them; its end lies coiled on the shelf.

objects.label: Scree gully
objects.desc: A steep chute of loose grey stone between ribs of rock, dropping away east from the shelf into the cloud: the only line down that is not sheer.

objects.label: Tser Falls
objects.desc: The falls thunder past a stone's throw west of the shelf, a white wall going up and down out of sight.

objects.label: Mordenkainen, if already restored at M, may be met here searching for his staff and spellbook (p.39). Not a fight.

rooms.name: The Cauldron
rooms.desc: A canyon floor walled in on three sides by black, streaming rock that climbs out of sight into the cloud. The falls hammer into a heaving pool, the roar is everywhere, and far overhead a hair-thin arch spans the sky.
rooms.dm: Speech must be shouted; nothing is heard beyond 30 ft. Within 80 ft of the fall: difficult ground, lightly obscured. Inside the standing wave: DC 15 Athletics each round or be pushed under; an hour in the water, DC 10 Con or a level of exhaustion. Walls: magic or a climber's kit only. G is 1.3 mi down the footpath (40 min).

rooms.name: The spray cave
rooms.desc: A dry hollow behind the curtain of the falls: a dead fire ring, mud-caked hides, the smell of old smoke.
rooms.dm: Hidden from the path, the bar and the south-west shore; found only by wading the north wall through the spray. Mountain folk (berserkers caked in grey mud, p.30) shelter here.

objects.label: The Cauldron walls
objects.desc: Sheer, wet, black-streaked rock going up and up into the cloud, leaning in at the top so the sky is a ragged oval.

objects.label: The plunge pool
objects.desc: Grey-green water, white and heaving where the falls hit it, ringed by a standing wave; cold enough to take the breath.

objects.label: Tser Falls
objects.desc: A white sheet coming down out of the cloud nearly a thousand feet, ropes of foam in it, a curtain of spray at its foot.

objects.label: Gravel bar and mud bank
objects.desc: A bar of rounded grey shingle across the pool's outlet, backed by a bank of fine grey silt that takes a footprint perfectly.

objects.label: Bare footprints and a drag mark in the silt, from the bank across the bar toward the north wall. DC 12 Survival: two or three people, barefoot, within the day, and they went into the water on purpose.
The snag jam
objects.desc: Whole dead pines carried over the falls and wedged across the outlet in a bleached tangle, polished bone-smooth by the river.

objects.label: In the jam: strap, buckle, rotted boot, thigh bone (staff or spellbook: DM option)
objects.desc: Caught among the trunks: a leather satchel strap and buckle, a rotted boot, a human thigh bone.
objects.dm: DC 15 Perception or an hour's search. The book says only that the Mad Mage lost his staff and spellbook in the fall (p.39): put them here if you want them found; otherwise the empty strap says the river had them first.

objects.label: Scavengers' stake and hook
objects.desc: A pine stake driven into the bar with a coil of wet rope and a four-pronged iron hook on it, the rope's end lying across the jam.

objects.label: The stake carries a Vistani knot (DC 10 Investigation, or any Vistana): the Tser Pool camp set it and comes back for the jam after every storm.
The spray cave (berserkers' shelter)
objects.desc: An undercut behind the north edge of the falling water: dry at the back, a dead fire ring, mud-caked hides, a chipped stone axe head.
objects.dm: Invisible from the path, the bar and the south-west shore; found by wading the north wall waist-deep through the spray.

objects.label: Foot of the scree gully
objects.desc: A chute of loose grey stone coming down the north wall from far above, spilling a fan of scree onto the shore.

objects.label: The bridge, far overhead
objects.desc: Looking straight up: a hair-thin dark arch across the ragged oval of sky, nearly a thousand feet overhead.

objects.label: Rusted wolf trap under the needles
objects.desc: A rusted iron wolf trap half hidden under pine needles on the path.
objects.dm: Hunting trap (p.31): DC 15 Survival for the front rank to spot it.

objects.label: Berserker (mountain folk, grey mud)
objects.dm: Day 14 / night 12, 1d4 (p.29-30). Shelter in the spray cave; seen only by a passive Perception beating their Stealth. They withdraw behind the water and fight only if followed in or cornered.

objects.label: Berserker on the bar, with a drift log
objects.playerLabel: A grey shape on the bar
objects.dm: Crouched on the bar, the mud on him matching the stones. Withdraws into the cave if seen.

objects.label: The Mad Mage (restored), in elk form
objects.dm: Only if the party has already restored Mordenkainen at M: he picks through the jam for his staff and spellbook (p.39), refuses help and leaves when he has looked.

objects.label: Overhead: the bridge, a thin dark line nearly a thousand feet up. By day the skeletal rider is a speck crossing it; at night its dead lantern shows nothing. A spark up there is a living traveller's torch.
The footpath from the Tser Pool camp (G): about 1.3 mi of muddy riverbank, 40 min. Deck to pool by road and path: H, F, G, here: about 9 mi, 3 hours.
